CustomField.description: Set manually by the SOA user (or a dedicated action) to signal a deliberate Contract Term change on an Amendment Quote. Automatically reset to false after the QLI End Date recalculation runs. Must never be set automatically from Contract_Term_Months__c changing, since that field is also rewritten by the native pricing engine on unrelated reprices (Quantity/Product changes, Reprice All).
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Check this, along with changing Contract Term (Months), to intentionally recalculate the QLI End Date. Do not rely on this being set automatically.
CustomField.label: Term Change Requested
